
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
import subprocess
import sys
from skimpy import skim
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

load_dotenv()
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
```

```{python}
# setup connection variables to local sql db
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
# Load data
df = pd.read_sql_table("population", engine)
cols = df.columns
```

### Missingness

```{python}
# return number and percentage of NA values in each column
print(skim(df))
```

```{python}
# check for zero values in each column 
[df[df[i].isin([0, "0", 0.0])] for i in cols]
```

### Summary Stats

```{python}
print(df.describe().round(2))
```

### Statitical Distribution Plots

```{python}

# Hisogram
sns.histplot(data=df, x=cols[2])
plt.show()
```

### Checking Intra-Data-Source Correlation

```{python}
sns.pairplot(df, corner=True)
plt.show()
```
